name: Amazon Bedrock
short: Managed access on AWS to frontier and open models - Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Google Gemma, OpenAI gpt-oss, xAI Grok, Z.ai GLM, Qwen, and more - with on-demand, batch (50% off), priority (75% premium), flex (50% off), and provisioned-throughput billing. Per-region prices vary.

plans.name: On-demand
plans.notes: Gemma 4 26B A4B in US East: $0.13 input / $0.40 output.

plans.name: Batch inference
plans.notes: Asynchronous jobs for select models; results returned within 24 hours.

plans.name: Priority & Flex tiers
plans.notes: Priority tier = 75% premium over Standard (latency-sensitive workloads); Flex tier = 50% discount (trades latency for lower per-token rates).

plans.name: Provisioned Throughput
plans.notes: Reserved capacity billed hourly with no per-token charge; commitments available.
